scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mangaverse/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @mangaverse/api" "npm run dev -w @mangaverse/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mangaverse/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @mangaverse/api && npm run build -w @mangaverse/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @mangaverse/shared && npm run test -w @mangaverse/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mangaverse/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mangaverse/api && npm run typecheck -w @mangaverse/web
